q: Which student did not give a unit?
Calculate the mean length of the pencil from Anna, Bao and Chloe.
Anna says her result is right because it is the biggest. Evaluate this, and suggest why the results differ.

Bigger is not more correct. Results differ by 0.1 cm, about one small division, from where the eye was or whether the pencil started at exactly zero. Repeating and taking the mean gives the best value.
